items: 【Durable Chair Covers】BROSYDA Patio Chair Covers adopt heavy duty 600D Oxford(Polyster) fabric, which is featured with high material density and wear resistant, No Fade No Cracks, super durable and long lasting for years. This Outdoor Chair Cover is made to keep elements like Sun, Dirt, Rain, Snow off your Patio Furniture.

【Upgraded Waterproof】The whole Patio Chair Cover is treated with PU waterproof coating inside to protect your chairs from Rainstorms or Snowstorms. In addition, all seams are Double-stitched and attached with Waterproof Tape to get the best waterproof effect.

【Easy to Set up/ Remove】Our Lawn Chair Covers are designed with 4 Click-close Straps and Cord Lock Closure at the bottom to firmly secure the cover in place, which makes it easier to set up. The Padded Handles on the Air Vent help removing the covers quickly.

【Universal Size】Brosyda Large Chair Cover measures to be 38" W x 31" D x 29" H, suitable for most kinds of Outdoor Patio Chairs, Deep Seat, Sofa, High Back Chair, Couch. Measure your Chairs before placing order, please.

【Great Shopping Experience】As an outdoor and home oriented brand, BROSYDA is committed to making your life better. We provide 1-year warranty and free services for all quality issue products,if you got any questions about set up and quality, we will take quick response to assist you.
